  critical [Functional Correctness]
  → src/sync.ts:10-12

  Await every save call and propagate failures.

  forEach does not await asynchronous callbacks. Therefore, saveAll
  resolves before the saves complete, and a rejected save promise does not
  reject saveAll. Preserve the previous sequential behavior with an
  awaited loop.


  Proposed fix

  -  items.forEach(async (item) => {
  -    await save(item);
  -  });
  +  for (const item of items) {
  +    await save(item);
  +  }
